summary: @SarahLWasserman The active learning strategies matter more than the delivery technology. That said I like Zoom for the Brady Bunch view which doesn't privilege speakers and use a lot of smaller breakout rooms for small group chat.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @SarahLWasserman The active learning strategies matter more than the delivery technology. That said I like Zoom for the Brady Bunch view which doesn't privilege speakers and use a lot of smaller breakout rooms for small group chat.
